subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 01, 2026
body:
**September 1, 2026 AcreetionOS Newsletter**

**Exciting News: OpenShot 4.0 Released!**

We're thrilled to share that OpenShot 4.0, a powerful video editor, has been released! This update brings significant improvements, including color grading, audio ducking, and more. As a community-driven project, AcreetionOS is always on the lookout for innovative tools to enhance our users' experience. We're excited to see how this new version will help our community create stunning videos.

**Community News**

* Netdev 0x1A videos and slides are now live, covering the latest developments in networking.
* Security updates have been issued by Debian and Fedora, ensuring our users have the latest patches and fixes.

**Practical Tip:**

**Customize Your AcreetionOS Experience with Calamares**

Did you know that you can customize your AcreetionOS installation experience using Calamares, our universal Linux installer? With Calamares, you can create a tailored installation process that suits your needs. Whether you want to add specific packages or modify the installation settings, Calamares makes it easy. Check out our wiki guides for more information on how to get started.

Stay up-to-date with the latest developments, and don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or need assistance. Happy computing with AcreetionOS!

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
